component.name: Graphiti MCP Server
component.summary: MCP server for temporal knowledge graphs

description.p: Graphiti MCP Server exposes an AI-agent memory system backed by a temporal knowledge graph. It supports episodic ingestion, entity and fact search, provenance lookup, saga summaries, and community detection.

The Debian package uses the Model Context Protocol over standard input and output and connects to an externally managed Neo4j service. A companion package can register the server in mcprack with mutating tools disabled.
